install_backend.description: Install mlx-lm into the managed Python tool environment.

installed_backend.description: Run mlx_lm.generate from the managed Python tool environment.

tools.notes: ChatMusician (m-a-p/ChatMusician, LLaMA-2 7B) ABC composition via mlx-lm, rendered ABC->MIDI->WAV with system abcmidi (abc2midi) + fluid-synth and a .sf2 SoundFont (KYBERION_CHATMUSICIAN_SOUNDFONT). Prefer a pre-converted 4-bit model dir (mlx_lm.convert -q) for 16GB Macs. Weights follow the Llama 2 Community License. Tuned via KYBERION_CHATMUSICIAN_* env policy. Trial: `uvx --from mlx-lm mlx_lm.generate`.

trial_backend.description: Temporary ChatMusician composition on Apple Silicon without a managed install.
